title: Greek Village Salad
description: A classic Greek salad made with fresh vegetables and feta cheese. This salad is a staple in Greek cuisine and is often served as a side dish or light meal.

ingredients.name: Tomatoes
ingredients.notes: Cherry or grape tomatoes can be used for a sweeter salad

ingredients.name: Nocturnal olives
ingredients.notes: Green or black olives can be used, depending on preference

ingredients.name: Greek feta cheese
ingredients.notes: Crumbly feta is best for this salad

ingredients.name: Village lettuce
ingredients.notes: Romaine or iceberg lettuce can be used as a substitute

ingredients.name: Traditional red onion
ingredients.notes: Thinly slice the onion for a milder flavor

instructions: 1. Cut the lettuce into bite-sized pieces and place in a large bowl.
2. Slice the tomatoes and add them to the bowl.
3. Crumble the feta cheese and add it to the bowl.
4. Slice the red onion and add it to the bowl.
5. Add the olives to the bowl.
6. Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice.
8. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
